text:
mika-cs: Onboarding hiccup: client reports a burst of 401s then 429s during app rollout (~200 devices). They use ephemeral tokens from their backend.

pablo-platform: Can you grab a log snippet and SDK version?

mika-cs: android-sdk 1.3.8. Logs:

```
E/Client: POST /v1/respond 401 missing auth
E/Client: fetch /session-token
E/Client: POST /v1/respond 429 rate_limit window=60s
```

They call mobileSdk.init() from multiple activities on cold start.

kevin-eng: Likely token stampede + retry amplification. Quick asks: are they awaiting token promise before making generate calls? Are they attaching Authorization per request via interceptor?

tara-support: Remediation we send: 1) Serialize SDK.init with a process-wide guard, 2) add small randomized delay (200-1500ms) after token arrival before sending heavy fanout, 3) configure SDK to coalesce preflight. Example option: set maxPreflight=3 and tokenJitterMs=1000.

pablo-platform: Short-term server tweak: have their token endpoint reuse a recent ephemeral token for a few seconds under load to smooth issuance. Also, enforce replay-once with backoff on 401.

mika-cs: I'll send the code snippet and KB. Will ask them to upgrade to 1.3.9 (contains token race fix).

ops-bot: [metric] rate.window.ignite spike -> 429 up 310% last 5m.

kevin-eng: If they still see issues after changes, we'll schedule a quick screenshare to inspect thread dumps and connection pool usage.

mika-cs: Update: customer applied single-init guard + 1s jitter; 429s returned to baseline. Closing the thread and adding mobile init guidance to onboarding checklist.
